name: Auto
summaryLine: Weapons with this property can only fire in burst, penetrating, or rapid modes.

name: Bright
summaryLine: This weapon's damage becomes fire, and its luminous property sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet while activated, instead of only dim light in a 5-foot radius.

name: Brutal
summaryLine: When you score a critical hit with a weapon with the brutal property, you roll a number of additional weapon damage dice equal to the brutal number.
